## Summary

The `pr-ready` gate now triggers like `UT`/`Code Check` (`pull_request_target`) and runs each suite on the runner it needs: Node tests + line coverage on the Linux `dm-nodeut` pool, Hypium and device ST on the macOS `harmonyos` runner, and a final job that merges the results into the same `gate-reports/pr-ready.json` the dashboard consumes.

## Changes

### Trigger

- `pull_request` → `pull_request_target` (opened/synchronize/reopened/ready_for_review), replaced rather than added so a PR does not run twice.
- Fork PRs no longer need "Approve and run workflows"; the workflow file always comes from the base branch, and only the tarball snapshot of the PR head is executed with `contents: read`.
- Concurrency is keyed by PR number (`pull_request_target` reports the base branch as `github.ref`), so different PRs do not cancel each other.

### Job split

| Job | Runner | Content |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pr-ready-node-ut` | Linux `dm-nodeut` (2 dedicated + flex) | `scripts/ci/node-ut.sh`: node suite + `NODE_V8_COVERAGE` + coverage threshold |
| `pr-ready-hypium-ut` | macOS `harmonyos` | `scripts/ci/hypium-ut.sh` |
| `pr-ready-st` | macOS `harmonyos` | `scripts/ci/st.sh` (credential-free attachment-policy ST) |
| `pr-ready-report` | Linux `dm-utility` | merges the three parts into `gate-reports/pr-ready.json` |

The jobs stay ordered (`node-ut` → `hypium-ut` → `st` → `report`); a failed prerequisite skips the rest and still produces a failing report. Job names carry a `pr-ready-` prefix so their checks do not collide with `ut.yml`'s `node-ut`/`hypium-ut`. The report job loads `scripts/gate/merge-pr-ready.mjs` and `.github/ci-gates.json` from the **base** snapshot, so PR code cannot rewrite its own verdict. Artifact uploads remain best-effort; the merged status comes from job outcomes with durations from `ci-gate-part-*`.

### Coverage

- `scripts/ci/node-tests.sh` picks up `profiling-report.test.mjs` and `performance.test.mjs`; UT's node-ut already ran them and the lists had drifted.
- `coverage-gate.mjs` now prints the real scope. On this branch: **575 production `.ets` files under the roots, 51 loaded by tests (8.9%), 524 never loaded and excluded from the denominator**; the reported **77.0–77.3% line coverage is over the 51 loaded files only**, not the module. Threshold stays on loaded files so the gate does not collapse before the loaders are fixed; the scope line makes the gap explicit.
- Why files are missing: many tests load `.ets` snippets through `vm.runInThisContext/runInNewContext` without a real `filename` (4 support loaders plus 83 test files use inline vm). Fixing those and including unloaded files requires recalibrating `COVERAGE_MIN_LINES` — proposed as a follow-up.

## Validation

- Local `node scripts/gate/gate.mjs run --lane pr-ready`: **pass**, 335s (node-ut 142.6s, hypium 161.2s, st 31.3s).
- Unit tests: `merge-pr-ready` 4/4, gate/coverage suite 16/16; actionlint clean apart from the existing custom-label and SC2115 notes.
- Dispatched workflow run [41185423737](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/actions/runs/41185423737): **all four jobs success** — node-ut 80s, hypium 336s, st 27s; `ci-gates-reports` contains `pr-ready` verdict `pass` with the three commands and durations.

## Caveats

- Edits to `ci.yml`/`scripts/ci/*` take effect in the PR gate after they land on main; validate inside a PR with `workflow_dispatch --ref <branch>` or locally.
- PR code still executes on self-hosted runners without approval (same class of risk as `UT/node-ut` and `Code Check`); the ST suite stays credential-free.

## Retire UT

`ut.yml` is deleted too. `pr-ready-node-ut` (#214) and `pr-ready-hypium-ut` already run the same suites, on the same runner split, with the same `pull_request_target` trigger and tarball fetch — keeping UT meant the Node suite ran twice per pull request and the two file lists kept drifting.

- `ci-gate.test.mjs` now asserts the CI jobs, the per-runner layout, the tarball fetch, and that `ut.yml` does not come back; the `ENABLE_HYPIUM_UT` assertions are gone.
- Node discovery has one source of truth: `scripts/ci/node-tests.sh`.
- Full node suite after the change: 2450 pass, 2 skipped.

After merge, delete the leftover **UT** workflow registration in Actions (sidebar → UT → ⋯ → Delete workflow), the same cleanup as `diag-st` / `E2E nightly`. The `ENABLE_HYPIUM_UT` repository variable is now unused and can be removed.

## Retire Claude PR Review

`claude-review.yml` is removed as well. It was gated by `vars.ENABLE_AI_REVIEW == 'true'`, which is not set — the last 100 runs were all `skipped`, so it only added a skipped check to every pull request. The publisher-script tests in `issue-workflows.test.mjs` were removed with it (the issue-template tests stay, 30/30).

`ANTHROPIC_*` secrets stay: the Nightly E2E job uses them for AI scoring. After merge, delete the **Claude PR Review** registration in the Actions sidebar (same cleanup as UT). `ENABLE_AI_REVIEW` was never set, nothing to remove there.

401.body:
## What this fixes

A turn that stops receiving events while the websocket stays healthy leaves the UI in "running" indefinitely. Reconnect reconciliation only runs when the connection drops (`CloudChatManager.reconcileAfterReconnect`), so a silent turn is never checked and the user is left with a half sentence and no way to tell whether the answer is still coming — the exact现场 in #379 (回复只有「我核对一下具体是谁说的。」，之后无任何输出，也没有失败提示或重试入口).

The session now watches that silence itself: after one minute without any event on a turn that still owes output, the conversation raises a single `warn` notice ("云端仍在处理，近一分钟没有新的输出。可以继续等待，或停止任务后重试。"). It never changes the run state, never fabricates a failure, and disappears the moment the cloud says anything again.

Fixes #398. Fixes #379 (user-visible report of the same quiet-turn hang). See also #373 (execution-time opacity).

## How it works

`CloudSession`:

- `watchQuiet()` restarts the silence clock and drops a shown hint. It is called from `beginTurn()` and on every frame the session accepts in `apply()`, so only a genuine gap counts.
- The timer fires at most once per quiet stretch (`quietHint` latches until the next event), only while `state` is `running` or `sending` — a paused turn, a turn waiting on an unanswered question, a stopped turn and a finished turn all have their own state and never see the hint.
- `settleQuiet()` stops the clock and removes the hint on `finishTurn()` and on `beginTurn()` of the next turn, so nothing leaks across turns.
- The hint is only placed when `notice` is empty: a real error/notice is never overwritten.
- The threshold is a constructor parameter (`new CloudSession(id, quietHintMs)`), defaulting to the exported `QUIET_HINT_MS = 60000`; tests pass a short value instead of sleeping a minute.

No new protocol, no server change, no new dependency, no logging of prompt/response content, no permission change. Rollback is a revert of two files.

## Tests (failing first)

`tests/unit/cloud-session-quiet-watch.test.mjs` — 7 cases, real `CloudSession` through the existing `tests/support/cloud-test-loader.mjs`, no device or backend.

Red first: before the change the suite failed with `assert.ok(session.notice)` — a silent running turn produced no notice at all.

| Case | Expectation |
| --- | --- |
| running turn, no events | `warn` notice containing「仍在处理」, `state` stays `running` |
| output resumes | notice cleared at once, bubble text continues normally |
| turn finished before the threshold | no notice, `state` is `idle` |
| turn waiting on the user (`chat.ask_user_question`) | no notice (`state` is `waiting`) |
| a real notice already shown | untouched (`连接已中断` stays) |
| silence continues | notice does not repeat |
| next turn starts | no leftover notice from the previous turn |

Green after the change: 7/7. Whole `cloud-*` unit set on this branch: 517 pass / 3 fail, and the 3 failures are the missing local devDependencies (`typescript` ×2, `playwright` ×1) that `ut.yml` installs — none of them touches `CloudSession`.

## Non-goals

- No automatic failure state, no new terminal state, no retry RPC: the client cannot verify the turn is dead, and inventing a failure would be worse than the silence.
- No server-side change; if the cloud really stops answering, a proper terminal event still has to come from the backend (#367/#379).
- No change to execution/step presentation (that is #373/#375).

## Risk

The only risk is a false alarm during a legitimately long non-streaming tool phase (#322): the notice is worded as "still working", changes no state, blocks no input, is cleared by the next event and appears once per quiet stretch, with a one-minute threshold. Worst case the user sees one informational line on a long turn.

403.body:
## What this fixes

Markdown emphasis in a Chinese reply leaked its markers into the bubble and broke the sentence style:

- `***两者***` rendered as `*` + bold `两者` + `*`
- `**粗体 *内斜* 混排**` rendered as five spans (`*`, italic `粗体 `, plain `内斜`, italic ` 混排`, `*`) — the outer bold was lost entirely

Cause: the bold branch of `parsePlainInline()` only accepted content without an asterisk (`\*\*([^*]+)\*\*`), so any nested emphasis made the whole span fail and the leftover markers fell through as plain text.

Fixes #402. Same rendering pipeline as #357 (multi-line content shown unrendered) and independent of #360 (table separator rows).

## How it works

`digitalmate/cloud-adapter/src/main/ets/workswarm/CloudMarkdown.ets`:

- The bold branch now accepts inner emphasis: `\*\*((?:[^*]|\*[^*]+\*)+)\*\*`, which covers `**粗体 *内斜* 混排**`, and `***x***` (the inner `*x*` matches, so the whole triple form lands on the bold branch).
- The captured text has its inner `*` markers removed before the span is created: `Inline` carries a single style, so the outer bold wins and no marker reaches the bubble. A numeric inner pair is the exception: `**5*3*2 = 30**` is arithmetic, so its asterisks stay literal (`boldPlainText()`), while `***x***` keeps rendering as bold `x`.
- Ordered before the backtick branch as before, so inline code and fenced code keep their asterisks literal.

No new dependency, no protocol change, no content dropped — only the markers.

## Tests (failing first)

New `tests/unit/cloud-markdown-emphasis.test.mjs`, 4 cases; red on `0fb0456` (each assertion showed the stray `*` spans above), green after the fix.

| Case | Expectation |
| --- | --- |
| `***两者***` | one bold span, text `两者` |
| `价格 ***99*** 元` | `价格 ` + bold `99` + ` 元` |
| `**粗体 *内斜* 混排**` | one bold span, text `粗体 内斜 混排` |
| `结论：**关键 *点* 已确认**。` | prefix + one bold span + `。` |
| `**粗体**`, `*斜体*`, `==高亮==`, `**粗体** 与 *斜体*` | unchanged |
| `` `a *** b` `` | literal `a *** b` inside a code span |

Whole markdown set on this branch (`cloud-markdown`, `cloud-markdown-links`, `cloud-markdown-layout`, `markdown-render-st`, plus the new suite): **65 pass / 0 fail**.

## Non-goals

- No nested rich text: `Inline` keeps its single-style contract, the outer span wins.
- No change to table recognition (#360's area) or to linkification.
- No new dependency, no logging, no permission change.

## Risk

The only new behaviour is that literal asterisks nested inside a bold span are dropped, except for a numeric inner pair, which stays literal because dropping it would change the value the user reads (`**5*3*2 = 30**` used to become `532 = 30`). A product written with one star and no closing partner (`**2*3**`) is not matched by the bold branch at all and behaves as before (verified: `*` + italic `2` + `3**` on both `0fb0456` and this branch) — the earlier example in this description was wrong. Code spans are matched first and keep their asterisks, and the existing behaviours (`**bold**`, `*italic*`, ``code``) are pinned by the tests. Rollback is a one-line regex revert plus the handler line.

## 问题

引用条（回复气泡上方的 `Beebou：…`）和输入框里的「引用回答」卡片显示的是 `markdownPreviewText()` 的输出。它在 `main` `0fb0456` 上有三个可见缺陷：

1. **截断没有省略号**：预览在 140 个 UTF-16 码元处硬切，被切断的半句话看起来像完整回答。
2. **emoji 处出现方块**：切口落在代理对中间时留下半个字符（`'答'×139 + '😀…'` → 尾部 `\ud83d`），渲染为 �。
3. **表格泄漏源码**：表格回答的预览是 `| 城市 | 温度 | | 北京 | 12 |`，用户看到 `|` 与 `---` 分隔行。

Fixes #404

## 改动

`digitalmate/cloud-adapter/src/main/ets/workswarm/CloudReplyPreview.ets`（+34/−6）：

- `clipCharacters()`：按 UTF-16 码点边界截断，绝不切开代理对（截断点落在高位代理上时回退一个码元）。
- `clipPreview()`：只有真的超长才补 `…`，未超长的预览保持原样（与 `permissionDetail` 等处的 `…` 约定一致）。
- 表格块（`kind === 'code' && table`）走既有的 `parseMarkdownTable()`，按单元格扁平化为 `城市 温度 北京 12`，不再输出 `|`。
- 解析上限 4096 也用同一套安全截断，避免解析入口产生孤立代理。

不动气泡正文渲染、不动流式管线、不改 Markdown 解析器（#402 处理正文强调，二者不重叠）。

## 测试

新增 `tests/unit/cloud-reply-preview.test.mjs`，**先失败后通过**（在 `0fb0456` 上 4 条中 3 条失败：缺省略号、`\ud83d` 孤立代理、`|` 泄漏；修复后 4/4 通过）：

```
node --test tests/unit/cloud-reply-preview.test.mjs
```

回归范围：

```
node --test tests/unit/cloud-*.test.mjs tests/unit/digitalmate-message-actions.test.mjs
ℹ tests 532 · pass 529 · fail 3
```

3 条失败全部是本地缺依赖导致的既有基线，与本次改动无关：`Cannot find module 'typescript'`（`cloud-account-service`、`cloud-embedding`）、`Cannot find module 'playwright'`（`cloud-math-renderer`）；CI 的 `ut.yml` 会安装这些依赖。既有的「公式在预览里必须可读」契约测试（`digitalmate-message-actions.test.mjs`）保持通过。

## 未验证

- 真机字体/换行下的实际显示：仓库无 ArkTS 工具链与真机，只能靠 CI 的 ArkTS Code Check 与纯函数测试。
- 未改动任何服务端或协议行为。

## 风险与回滚

预览文本形状变化（长文多一个 `…`、表格由 `|` 变空格），UI 侧本就用 `maxLines` + `TextOverflow.Ellipsis`，不冲突。改动是单文件纯函数，回滚只需 revert 这一个 commit。

<sub>Fledge · DigitalMate · Lead · maintained</sub>

查看没有云端 result 消息的失败结果时，原来无法消费未读回执；移除“知道了”后也缺少手动清理入口。现在统一任务结果的已读处理，并为所有提醒提供单条清理和一键清理，保留任务与聊天记录。

- 当前结果可见时自动标已读，包括本地生成的失败行；旧执行结果和旧页面版本不会误读新结果。打开提醒概览不会批量标已读，查看也不会发送 notification.dismiss。
- 清理同一提醒组的全部事件；一键清理只处理确认时捕获的提醒，按 100 条分批发送，保留新到消息和新版本结果。失败时保留未确认条目，切换账户后停止旧操作。
- 服务端支持 task、message、signal、decision 清理。运行中的任务也能清理其对应版本的提醒；已在别处回答的卡片不会阻塞整批清理。清理不停止任务、不自动批准/拒绝卡片、不删除任务或对话。关联消息副本同步清理。

覆盖本轮审查的 [F1：无 durable result 的失败提醒无法已读](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/406#discussion_r4431201586) 和 [F2：缺少手动清理入口](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/406#issuecomment-6541557847)。按本次确认的交互，保留显式“清理提醒”，并扩展到所有类型与一键清理。

验证：

- 171 项相关客户端测试通过；17 项服务端通知测试与 24 项对话测试通过（共 41 项）。包含运行中任务清理、已回答卡片并发变化、版本/账户隔离和批量失败保留。
- 从本 PR 实现 checkout 完成 HAP 构建（本地禁用签名）；git diff --check 通过。
- 完整 Node 测试：2448 项，2436 通过、5 失败、7 skipped。5 项失败均在原 PR head 9f7945b6 复现，涉及 Windows 的 fake-kubectl、目录 fsync 和路径分隔符；未将其记为通过。
- dm_phone（5555，1320×2232）已覆盖安装 10066，并核对提醒概览及历史记录中的清理入口。该包是在原联调包源码 04621bb9 上叠加本 PR 客户端补丁、保留原开发配置的集成包；本机服务端同步叠加通知补丁，使用独立端口和原本机工作区的副本。受保护快照返回 9 个任务、31 条消息。未修改飞书模拟器或共享云端；截图不代表“运行中清理”的原生端到端验收，该场景目前由服务端回归测试覆盖。

完整清理功能需要客户端与服务端一起更新。开发凭据、TLS 私钥、签名材料、本机配置、HAP 与原始 API 回执均不进入 PR。[详细验证与包来源](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/cfa211dcc0540de1a69d60d32dae34c02ae56a68/docs/developer_guide/validation/issue255-reminders-20261031/README.md)。

## 问题

「执行步骤」卡片、子代理活动行和步骤摘要都经过 `brief()`（`CloudMessage.ets`）。它只认 `data:` URL 一种二进制形态，而且 scheme 匹配会跨过 JSON 引号：

1. **裸露 base64 不被遮蔽**：`{"image_base64":"iVBORw0KGgo" + "A"×600}` 原样输出 612 个字符（最长到 12000 字符上限），图片生成工具的字节铺满步骤卡片。
2. **多个内联 data URL 被合并**：`{"images":["data:...","data:..."]}` → `{"images":["[二进制内容]"]}`，第二张图消失——`data:[^\s]+;base64,` 会吃到最后一个 `;base64,`，把中间字段吞掉。

Fixes #407

## 改动

`digitalmate/cloud-adapter/src/main/ets/workswarm/CloudMessage.ets`（+6/−1）：

- `data:[^"\s]+;base64,` —— 遇到引号即止，两个二进制条目各自遮蔽，JSON 结构与同级字段保持完整。
- 新增 `[A-Za-z0-9+/]{200,}={0,2}` —— 不带 scheme 的裸 base64（≥200 连续字符）同样折叠为 `[二进制内容]`；阈值远大于任何正常标识符，普通文本、短数字、URL 主机名与 `?download_token=` 既有遮蔽行为不变。
- 不改气泡正文、不改协议、不改任何网络行为。

## 测试

新增 `tests/unit/cloud-binary-mask.test.mjs`，**先失败后通过**（`0fb0456` 上 5 条中 2 条失败：裸 base64 未遮蔽、两个 data URL 合并；修复后 5/5）：

```
node --test tests/unit/cloud-binary-mask.test.mjs
```

回归范围（cloud-* 与 digitalmate-*）：

```
node --test tests/unit/cloud-*.test.mjs tests/unit/digitalmate-*.test.mjs
ℹ tests 1015 · pass 1012 · fail 3
```

3 条失败全部是本地缺依赖导致的既有基线，与本次改动无关：`Cannot find module 'typescript'`（`cloud-account-service`、`cloud-embedding`）、`Cannot find module 'playwright'`；CI 的 `ut.yml` 会安装这些依赖。

## 未验证

- 真机上步骤卡片的排版：仓库无 ArkTS 工具链与真机，只能靠 CI 的 ArkTS Code Check 与纯函数测试。
- 遮蔽阈值 200 是启发式：≥200 连续 `[A-Za-z0-9+/]` 视为编码数据。签名 URL 的超长路径段也会被折叠（主机名仍可见），这是有意的取舍。

## 风险与回滚

只影响步骤/活动文本的显示内容，不改变消息正文与协议。单文件纯函数，回滚只需 revert 这一个 commit。

409.body:
## 问题与目标

DigitalMate 启动器强制写入 WorkSwarm 严格审批策略，普通创建作文文件的命令也会触发权限卡。当前手机链路缺少对应审批凭据，最终只显示“请在云端处理此确认”，无法继续任务。

本次以部署配置控制工具权限检查，默认全部放行（包含删除），并保留 main 原有的细分平台策略。来源为用户反馈，无对应 Issue。当前目标 main 未提供 PR 模板，正文遵循 AGENTS.md 与 CONTRIBUTING.md。

## 最终行为

- 新增部署环境变量 `DIGITALMATE_WORKSWARM_PERMISSIONS_ENABLED`：未设置或设为 `false` 时关闭工具权限检查，不弹工具权限卡；设为 `true` 时启用原有平台细分权限策略。
- 保留 main 原有严格模式、默认询问、读取及指定搜索工具放行、部分搜索别名及付费搜索禁用规则。关闭总开关时这些权限规则不参与拦截，重新开启时生效。
- 额外配置的工具规则与 `rules`、file guard 等字段保留；平台预留工具名继续按 main 原有 allow/deny 策略设置。
- 非法开关值令启动失败，避免拼写错误意外关闭检查。

411.author: HugoXK
411.body:
## 问题

`chat.final` 的落地路径先解析「这条 final 覆盖哪个分段」，`parseChatFinalSegmentId()` 把四个候选字段塞进 `string[]` 后逐个 `.trim()`。帧是服务端下发的 JSON，`Payload.segment_id?: string` 只是编译期声明；消息 id 在服务端常是整数，`||` 只吞掉 `0`/`''`，非零数字会原样进入数组并让 `.trim()` 抛 `TypeError`。

在 `0fb0456` 上实测：

```
parseChatFinalSegmentId({ segment_id: 42 })        → TypeError: value.trim is not a function
session.apply({event:'chat.final',
  payload:{request_id:'turn', content:'最终回答', stream_message_id: 98765}})
                                                   → TypeError: value.trim is not a function
```

异常发生在帧分发里，被 `CloudConnection` 的 `try/catch` 转成 `onProtocolError('消息处理失败，详见通信日志')`：这条 final 的正文整条丢失，同一轮的 `finishTurn()` 也没执行，用户看到的是通用错误提示而不是回复。

Fixes #410

## 改动

`digitalmate/cloud-adapter/src/main/ets/workswarm/CloudFinal.ets`（+11/−6）：

- 候选值按 `string | undefined` 收集，逐个 `typeof value !== 'string'` 跳过，字符串路径仍 `trim()` 后返回；
- 四个字段都不可用时返回 `''`（表示写到客户端当前分段），不再抛异常；
- 与同文件 `parseChatFinalMode()` 已有的 `typeof raw !== 'string'` 校验保持一致。

不改协议、不改分段选择策略、不改任何网络行为；只是不再让一个可选字段的类型把整条 final 打掉。

## 测试

新增 `tests/unit/cloud-final-segment-id.test.mjs`，**先失败后通过**（`0fb0456` 上 4 条中 3 条失败）：

| 用例 | 断言 |
| --- | --- |
| 数字型 `segment_id` / `stream_message_id` | 返回 `''`，不抛异常 |
| 前一个候选不可用、后一个可用 | 取到 `'m-9'`；`'seg-1'` 原样返回；`'  seg-2  '` 被 trim |
| `parseChatFinalMode` 非字符串 | 仍返回 `''`（回归保护） |
| 带数字 `stream_message_id` 的 `chat.final` | 回复落进气泡、`completed === true`、会话回到 `idle` |

```
node --test tests/unit/cloud-final-segment-id.test.mjs   # 4/4
node --test tests/unit/cloud-*.test.mjs                  # 517 tests · 514 pass · 3 fail
```

3 条失败是本地缺依赖的既有基线（`Cannot find module 'typescript'` ×2、`'playwright'` ×1，CI 的 `ut.yml` 会安装），与本次改动无关。`CloudFinal.ets` 此前在 `tests/unit` 里没有任何覆盖，这个文件顺带补上。

## 未验证

- 服务端线上是否真的会下发数字型分段 id：仓库内没有服务端代码，无法证实。本 PR 修的是「客户端把可选字段做成硬失败点」这一可复现事实，而不是声称线上已发生。
- 真机渲染与 ArkTS 编译：沙箱无真机与 ArkTS 工具链，由 CI 的 ArkTS Code Check 覆盖。

## 风险与回滚

行为面很小：只有非字符串候选值从「抛异常」变成「跳过」。若服务端确实永远只发字符串，这个改动等价于空操作。回滚只需 revert 这一个 commit。

Fixes #412

## 这个 PR 做了什么

`cloudTaskNoticeText()`（`digitalmate/cloud-adapter/src/main/ets/workswarm/CloudTaskNotice.ets`）负责生成 workswarm 任务状态变化的系统通知文本，原来有两处问题：

1. 标题用 `title.slice(0, 24)`、正文用 `slice(0, 220)`，都按 **UTF-16 码元**切。切点落在 emoji 中间时留下孤立代理（`\ud83d`），系统通知渲染成方块。另外标题截断补 `…`、正文截断不补，行为不一致。
2. 正文做了 Markdown 清理（`/[#*`>|]/g`），标题只做 `trim()`，于是 `**`、反引号、`#`、`>`、`|` 原样进入通知标题。

改动：

- 新增 `clipNoticeText(text, limit)`：按码点遍历累计宽度，超限时不切半个代理并追加 `…`。
- 新增 `noticePlainText(text)`：去 Markdown 标记 + 折叠空白 + trim。
- 标题与正文都改走这两个函数；`'未命名会话'` 回退保持不变；长度上限语义仍是 24 / 220。

纯字符串处理层改动，无网络、存储、权限副作用。

## 测试

新增 `tests/unit/cloud-task-notice-text.test.mjs`，4 条用例：

| 用例 | `0fb0456` | 本分支 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 标题 23 汉字 + 😀，切点安全且补 `…` | ✖ 尾部 `\ud83d…` | ✔ |
| 正文 219 汉字 + 😀，切点安全且补 `…` | ✖ 尾部 `\ud83d` | ✔ |
| 标题去 Markdown 标记（`**周末** \`计划\``） | ✖ 原样输出 | ✔ |
| 空标题回退 `未命名会话`（防回归） | ✔ | ✔ |

也就是 3 条先红后绿，1 条防回归。

拿到的结果：

- `node --test tests/unit/cloud-task-notice-text.test.mjs` → 4/4 pass
- `node --test tests/unit/cloud-task-notice-text.test.mjs tests/unit/cloud-task-notifications.test.mjs` → 20/20 pass
- 回归 `node --test tests/unit/cloud-*.test.mjs tests/unit/digitalmate-*.test.mjs` → **1014 tests / 1011 pass / 3 fail**，3 条与本次改动无关，是环境既有噪声：`typescript` 模块缺失 ×2（`cloud-account-service`、`cloud-embedding`）、`playwright` 缺失 ×1（`cloud-math-renderer`）。

## 没有验证的部分

- 真机 / 模拟器通知栏的实际渲染效果（本环境无 HarmonyOS 设备与 ArkTS 工具链）。结论建立在字符串层面可复核的孤立代理与标记残留上，`tests/unit/cloud-task-notice-text.test.mjs` 就是这条证据的可执行形式。
- 通知分组、去重、投递时序未触碰，行为不变。

## 回滚

两个文件的改动（实现 + 测试），`git revert` 即回到原行为，无需迁移。

## 非目标

不新增通知类型、不改通知触发条件、不改权限、不引入 secret、不改变标题/正文长度上限语义。

415.body:
Fixes #414

## 这个 PR 做了什么

纯文档 + 一个契约测试，没有运行时代码、依赖、权限或设置改动（唯一的仓库元数据变化是新增 4 个标签名
`goal:P1`、`priority:P0`、`type:docs`、`source:goal`，供 issue #414 使用）。

产品迭代目标 v1 的 §10 要求四份产物先于功能落地，但仓库 `docs/` 没有产品目录，每轮都在重新论证定位。
本 PR 落地四份文档，并用一条契约测试把它们钉住：

| 文件 | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| `docs/product/positioning.md` | 一句话定位、目标用户、三条 JTBD、P1/P2/P3（每条含当前实现证据 / 差距 / 验收）、七条明确不做、三处定位冲突 |
| `docs/product/competitive-landscape.md` | 5 直接 + 3 间接竞品 × 10 维度；每行带 事实/推断/假设、来源、ISO 日期；附本轮复验记录与未核实清单 |
| `docs/product/roadmap-6m.md` | 6 个月只做三件事，分别对应 P1/P2/P3；各有 M1–M3 里程碑、可度量验收、不做清单、风险 |
| `docs/product/backlog.md` | 20 项按支柱排序：类型、优先级、四类标签、证据、用户故事、现状与差距、验收、非目标检查、为什么是我们、不做会怎样、风险、预估、链接 |
| `tests/unit/product-docs.test.mjs` | 7 条契约测试：文档存在与索引、定位句唯一、三支柱字段、竞品来源/日期/置信度、路线图恰三件事、backlog 恰 20 项并按优先级排序、相对链接可解析 |
| `docs/README.md` | 目录表新增 `product/` 一行 |

## 先红后绿（可复核）

文档改动同样能测试先行，所以这一轮拆成两个提交：

1. `8116d36` **只提交测试**。在干净的 `8116d36` worktree 上运行
   `node --test tests/unit/product-docs.test.mjs` → **7 tests / 7 fail**（文档尚不存在）。
2. `e9fb8a6` **加入四份文档与索引**。同一命令 → **7 tests / 7 pass**。

上一轮的问题之一是"文档改动没法先写失败测试"；这里的结论相反：只要是可检查的约束（来源、日期、置信度、
排序、数量），就能先写失败测试。约定不是叙事，能跑才算。

## 评审后的修正（第三提交）

`64ab1f8` 把三个「没有基线却写成验收」的数字标成目标：B01 的 90% 与 B06 的 2 秒标注为「目标，M1 校准」，
B06 改为相对 #223 基线的「P50 下降 ≥ 50%」，B10 的「静默时段 0 次通知」明确为硬性行为而非比例目标。
理由写进 backlog 的新增规则段：没有基线就写死百分比，会让下一轮误以为已经验收过。加完仍 7/7 通过。

## 三个竞品来源本轮重新读过

不编造结论；读不到就降级并写清楚。本轮实测（2026-10-31）：

| 来源 | 结果 | 处理 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `https://www.notion.com/help/notion-ai-faqs` | HTTP 200，读到正文 | 由推断升为事实（套餐、credits、Agent 建改页面、执行前审阅计划、权限继承） |
| `https://docs.letta.com/self-hosting/channels` | HTTP 200，读到正文 | 由推断升为事实（渠道清单、DM/群组策略、管理员分层、`/reflection`） |
| GitHub API `letta-ai/letta`、`mem0ai/mem0` | 200；均 Apache-2.0；LETTA README 已指向 `letta-code` | 支撑开源与自托管行，并注明仓库迁移 |
| `https://help.openai.com/en/articles/8590148-memory-faq` | HTTP 403（再次复验） | 保持推断/假设，记录在「证据缺口」表 |

顺带修正了上一版的两处不严谨：Mem0 的"2026 年 4 月新算法"没有来源，已删掉月份，只保留 README 描述；
Letta 的 MemFS / schedules 只从文档导航看到，已从"事实"降为"推断"并写明未读正文。

## 与 issue #414 的映射（明确写清）

本轮只开一个 issue：**#414 是这份基线的落地/追踪单**，不是 backlog 里的功能条目。backlog 的 20 项中
**B01（记忆溯源："为什么记得"可回答）是下一个 P0 候选**，它的验收标准已经写进 `backlog.md`，但实现不在
本 PR 内——需要下一轮按模板单独开 feature issue。`backlog.md` 里已有上游单的 6 项（B03→#250、B06→#223、
B09→#377、B13→#65、B16→#367/#358/#388、B11→#291）直接复用，不重复提。

## 复用了上一轮的骨架（如实说明）

上一轮的同类 PR #393（issue #392）已关闭未合并，但分支 `docs/product-baseline` 仍在，CI 双绿。本 PR 在
其文档骨架基础上做了三件事：补 `backlog.md` 与对应契约测试、按上面所述修正竞品证据等级、把四份文档互相
链接并在 `docs/README.md` 建索引。没有直接 cherry-pick 那个合并提交，而是从当前 `main` `04621bb` 重新
组织成"测试先、文档后"两个提交。

## 跑过与没跑

- `node --test tests/unit/product-docs.test.mjs` → 7/7 pass（`8116d36` 上 7/7 fail）
- `node --test tests/unit/*.test.mjs` → 1641 tests / 1602 pass / **32 fail**；32 条集中在 account / gateway /
  UI / memory-store 等与本 PR 无关的套件，基线对照见下一条
- 基线对照：在 `04621bb` 的干净 worktree 上跑同一命令 → 1634 tests / 1595 pass / **32 fail**。
  差值与分支完全一致：**+7 tests、+7 pass、失败数不变（32）**，失败集合逐条比对相同；唯一差异是
  `about-you-renderer-interaction.test.mjs` 内部哪条先报（该套件依赖 Chromium 交互，基线同样失败）。
  结论：本 PR 未引入回归，新增的 7 条契约测试全部通过
- 未跑：`hvigorw test`、ArkTS 构建、真机验证。本 PR 不碰 ArkTS 源码，这些检查由 CI 的 `node-ut` 与
  `ArkTS Code Check` 覆盖
- 未做：链接抓取式外链检查（离线环境只逐条 web_fetch 了表中列出的官方来源）；中文错别字工具未接入

## 回滚

`git revert e9fb8a6 8116d36` 即可完全回到 `04621bb` 的文档状态；两个提交都是新增文件 + 一行索引，
无迁移、无配置依赖。

## 非目标

不改产品定位本身（定位变更需人类批准，见 `positioning.md`「定位冲突」）；不创建 backlog 中尚无上游单的
14 条 issue；不把竞品结论当作任何功能立项理由；不引入新依赖或 CI 步骤。

## What this ships

One focused slice of backlog item **B01 记忆溯源** (`docs/product/backlog.md`): provenance metadata for a memory record + a pure zh/en renderer for the user-facing "why do you remember this?" sentence.

- New module `digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/memory/MemoryProvenance.ets` (183 lines, no imports, no new dependencies).
- `MemoryProvenance` = `{ source, sourceTurnId, recordedAt, reasonCode }`; reason codes `user_stated | user_confirmed | leader_inferred | imported | unknown`.
- `normalizeMemoryProvenance` / `memoryProvenanceFromRecord` project existing `MemoryRecord.sourceTurnId` + `createdAt` without touching storage.
- `memoryProvenanceSentence(input, locale)` renders zh or en; `en-*` selects English, everything else Chinese.
- Honest degradation: missing reason renders "没有记录 / not recorded"; empty provenance renders "来源未知 / source unknown"; `leader_inferred` always says it may be wrong.
- UTC-only dates, control-char stripping, 48-char cap on turn references, and the memory fact text is never passed in or echoed.

**Declared cuts:** no management-page UI, no reason-code persistence / DB migration, no wiring into `LongTermMemoryOverviewCoordinator` yet. Those are explicitly out of this PR; the module is the tested substrate for them.

Fixes #416

## Red-first, as real commits

- `f96f0e8` — **test only** (`tests/unit/memory-provenance.test.mjs`, 13 tests). On this commit the suite is red: 13/13 fail, every failure `ENOENT .../MemoryProvenance.ets` (module intentionally absent). Exit code 1.
- `aeb9da5` — implementation. Same command: **13/13 pass**, 0 fail, exit 0.

No fix and test in the same commit; the test file is unchanged between the two commits.

## Tests run

| Command | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `node --test tests/unit/memory-provenance.test.mjs` (red, `f96f0e8`) | 13 fail / 13, exit 1, all ENOENT |
| `node --test tests/unit/memory-provenance.test.mjs` (green, `aeb9da5`) | 13 pass / 13, 0 fail, exit 0 |
| `node --test tests/unit/*.test.mjs` (branch) | 1647 tests, 1608 pass, 32 fail, 7 skipped |
| same suite on baseline `04621bb` | 1634 tests, 1595 pass, 32 fail, 7 skipped |

The +13 tests / +13 passes are exactly this PR; the 32 failures are the known environment gaps (missing `typescript`, `playwright`, Chromium) and the failing set is identical to baseline apart from reporter naming.

**Not run locally:** ArkTS/`hvigorw` build and on-device rendering (no HarmonyOS toolchain here). The new file is pure ArkTS with no ArkUI imports.

## CI at callback time

- `node-ut`: **success**
- `ArkTS Code Check`: **success**
- `hypium-ut`, `auto-review`, `claude-mention`: skipped (repo defaults)

## Issue labels / repo metadata

Issue #416 carries `feature`, `goal:P1`, `priority:P0`, `source:goal`. `type:feature` **does not exist** in this repo, and this round forbids creating labels, so the issue was opened without it and without touching any repository metadata. No labels, protections, webhooks, secrets or settings were changed.

## Review

Per this round's rule, the COMMENT review must be posted by the DigitalMate Reviewer bot itself. It was asked to review this PR and ran for 15+ minutes, but **posted no review** (`GET /pulls/417/reviews` = 0 at callback time) and it has **no separate GitHub identity/token** in this environment. Posting from this account would be a self-review by the implementation account, so no review was posted and no review id is invented here.

## Privacy / security / rollback

- No secrets, tokens, prompt text or response bodies added; the renderer only receives provenance fields.
- No permission widening, no new dependency, no network or filesystem access in the module.
- Rollback: `git revert f96f0e8..aeb9da5` (one new module + one test file); no data migration, no feature flag needed.

同一张提问卡有多个问题时，端侧虽记录全部答案，WorkSwarm 回答条目却缺少 `question`，原生 AskUserRail 最后只收到最后一项自由文本。空回答补偿过程中若再次提问，补偿轮的 `chat.done` 又被丢弃，导致有待答问题的任务仍被标为完成。

Refs #152, #339, #379。本 PR 覆盖澄清后的续跑、独立提问期间的答案保留，以及中间回复后仍有新提问却提前完成的部分；这些 issue 的其他范围继续保持开放。

## What this ships

The export half of backlog item **B15**: one schema-versioned JSON format for long-term memory records plus a strict, validating parser. No UI, no file picker, no import write path, no storage or schema change.

- New module `digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/memory/MemoryExport.ets` (142 lines, no imports, no new dependencies).
- Fixed document: `{"schema":"digitalmate.memory.export","version":1,"exportedAt":<ms>,"records":[...]}`.
- Per-record whitelist: `memoryId / sceneId / personaTag / authority / fact / sourceTurnId / createdAt / updatedAt`. Embeddings, `ownerId`, `normalizedFact` and `factHash` are deliberately excluded.
- `parseMemoryExport` rejects wrong schema, non-1 version, malformed JSON, non-object documents, duplicate memory ids, unknown authority, multi-line facts, invalid/oversized fields, negative/non-integer timestamps, `updatedAt < createdAt`, and >5000 records.
- `exportMemoryJson` also refuses invalid input instead of dropping records.

Fixes #419

**Honest scope:** repo-wide search on this branch finds 31 `MemoryExport` hits, all inside the new module and its test. **No production file imports or calls it.** This PR ships unreferenced substrate with zero user-visible change; it is the tested contract for a later settings/export-UI slice, not a working export button.


**Declared cuts:** no settings-page export button, no file writing, no encryption/passphrase, no import write-back, no migration tool. This is the tested contract those slices will build on.

- `5500507` — **test only** (`tests/unit/memory-export.test.mjs`, 16 tests). Module intentionally absent. `node --test tests/unit/memory-export.test.mjs` → **16 fail / 16**, exit 1, every failure `ENOENT .../memory/MemoryExport.ets`.
- `0cd056d` — implementation only. Same command → **16 pass / 16**, 0 fail, exit 0.

## Issue labels / repo metadata

Issue #419 carries `feature`, `priority:P0`, `source:goal`. `goal:P3` and `type:feature` **do not exist** in this repo, and this round forbids creating labels, so the issue was opened without them. No labels, protections, webhooks, secrets or settings were changed.

The DigitalMate Reviewer bot has **no independent GitHub identity/token** in this environment. Per this round's rule its assessment will be posted as a COMMENT review by the implementation account, and that comment starts with the literal line:

## What this changes

The proactive daily reminder (P2 主动但不越界) is the one nudge DigitalMate sends without the user asking. Its title and content were hardcoded Chinese, so an English device got a notification it could not read. This resolves that local copy from the device language.

Fixes #426

## Reachability (not a standalone module)

`pages/A2uiHome/Index.ets:5525` — after a successful daily sentinel run:
`new BimDailyReminder().scheduleNext(now, digitalmateClientContext().language)`
→ `bim/BimDailyReminder.ets:121` `scheduleNext()` → `:122` `buildBimDailyReminderRequest(nextBimReminderAt(now), language)` (`:57`)
→ `reminderAgentManager.publishReminder(request)` → the system notification the user sees.

Debug build path is the same chain at `Index.ets:5561` → `scheduleDebug()` (`:125`) → `buildBimSentinelDebugReminderRequest()` (`:87`).

| commit | contents | result |

| `140c6b7` | test only, `tests/unit/bim-reminder-bilingual.test.mjs` (+106) | **4 fail / 2 pass**, exit 1 |

```
  - 'What is on your mind'

  + '检查心上事（测试）'
  - 'What is on your mind (test)'
✖ the sentinel call site passes the device language into the reminder
```

- `pages/A2uiHome/Index.ets:5499` `runDailyBimSentinel(..., scheduleNext = true)` 的唯一调用点 `Index.ets:5549` 传 `false`；

- **红 `53aa44e`**（仅测试，+84）→ `ℹ tests 5 / pass 2 / fail 3`，exit 1：

434.body:
## What

Three interactive controls in the CloudHome chat header are drawn as a bare glyph or a bare icon with no accessible name, so a screen reader announces the character or "image" instead of the action:

| Control | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| back chevron | `pages/CloudHome/Index.ets:1731` `Text('‹')` → announced as "‹" | `.accessibilityText('返回')` |
| session list | `pages/CloudHome/Index.ets:1752` `Image($r('app.media.ic_session_fold'))` → announced as "image" / "图片" | `.accessibilityText('会话列表')` |
| queue-edit close | `pages/CloudHome/Index.ets:2234` `Text('×')` → announced as "×" (multiplication sign) | `.accessibilityText('退出编辑')` |

One coherent defect class — *(i) icon-only / glyph-only control without accessible text* — one surface (the cloud chat page), one file changed. No layout, colour, size or interaction change; the visible glyphs are byte-identical.

`Fixes #433`

## Reachability (release path, hop by hop)

1. `digitalmate/entry/src/main/resources/base/profile/main_pages.json:6` registers `pages/CloudHome/Index`.
2. `pages/A2uiHome/Index.ets:363` `CLOUD_CHAT_ROUTE_URL: string = 'pages/CloudHome/Index'` routes to it.
3. `pages/CloudHome/Index.ets:2572` `if (!this.contentOnly) { this.Header() }` — the header renders on every normal chat open.
4. `pages/CloudHome/Index.ets:1728` `Header()` builds `:1731` (back chevron), `:1752` (session list, under `if (this.connectionState() === 'open')` at `:1751`), and `QueueBar` → `:2234` (queue-edit close, under `if (this.editingQueueId && !this.contentOnly)` at `:2231`).

No hop is behind a constant `false`, a debug flag or a dead branch: `pages/CloudHome/Index.ets` does not reference `isDebugBuild` at all, and the only conditions on the path are live UI state (`contentOnly`, `connectionState()`, `editingQueueId`).

## Test — red, green, mutation

- **Red** `c86fc69` (test only, +98) on `main` `04621bb`: `ℹ tests 2 / pass 0 / fail 2`, exit 1, verbatim:
  `AssertionError [ERR_ASSERTION]: digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/pages/CloudHome/Index.ets:1731 (the chat-header back chevron) must carry a non-empty accessible name, so a screen reader announces the action instead of the bare glyph or "image"`
- **Green** `7801fb2` (1 file, +3/−1): `ℹ tests 2 / pass 2 / fail 0`.
- Test file byte-identical between red and green: `git diff --stat c86fc69 7801fb2 -- tests/unit/cloud-chat-accessible-names.test.mjs` is **empty**.
- **Mutation check** (mandatory): `sed -i "s/        .accessibilityText('返回')//" …/CloudHome/Index.ets` → `ℹ tests 2 / pass 0 / fail 2`, same assertion as the red run; restored → `ℹ tests 2 / pass 2 / fail 0`.

The test reads the shipped page, finds each control's anchor line, walks its modifier chain up to the balanced `.onClick(` handler and requires a non-empty Chinese `.accessibilityText(...)` label, plus that the three names are distinct. A comment or an unrelated edit in the file cannot satisfy it; a control without its label cannot pass it.

## Chinese output

Byte-identical for every pre-existing string: all 121 distinct CJK string literals in `pages/CloudHome/Index.ets` (158 occurrences) are unchanged on the branch — zero removed or altered. The change only **adds** three labels: `返回` (6 bytes), `会话列表` (12 bytes), `退出编辑` (12 bytes). No English copy was added.

## Checks run

- `node --test tests/unit/cloud-chat-accessible-names.test.mjs` — red then green as above.
- Full suite on the branch vs `main` `04621bb`: **1806 tests / 1767 pass / 32 fail / 7 skipped** vs **1804 / 1765 / 32 / 7** — the 28 failing files are the same set on both sides (set difference empty).
- Not run: `hvigorw test` and on-device/emulator runs — this sandbox has no HarmonyOS/ArkTS toolchain, so the accessibility names were verified against the source the compiler consumes, not on a device.

## Non-goals held

No new module, no dependency, no permission, no server change, no locale framework, no change to `AboutYouPage.ets`, `AboutYouRenderer.ets`, `MemoryOverview.ets`, `pages/A2uiHome/Index.ets`, `BimDailyReminder.ets`, `A2uiHomeState.ets` or `StatusBadgeView.ets` (all owned by open PRs). The only edited file is `pages/CloudHome/Index.ets`, which no open PR touches at the time of writing.

## What

The composer attachment strip announced its two controls in Chinese only, so TalkBack on an `en` device read 「report.pdf，上传失败」 and 「移除附件 report.pdf」. The two announcements now follow the existing device-language value:

- `digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/files/FilePresentation.ets` — new pure helpers `composerFileStatusAnnouncement(name, status, language)` and `composerFileActionAnnouncement(name, status, language)` (plus `attachmentLanguageIsEnglish`). zh strings are the exact strings that were inline before; `en*` gets `, upload failed` / `, uploading` / `, uploaded` and `Cancel upload ` / `Remove attachment `.
- `digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/files/ComposerFileStrip.ets` — both `.accessibilityText(...)` calls now use the helpers with `this.language = digitalmateClientContext().language` (`model/DigitalMateDeviceContext.ets:14`, the value #425/#429 already use). No new module, dependency, permission, server call or locale framework.

Fixes #437

## Reachability (release path)

1. `resources/base/profile/main_pages.json:3` → `pages/A2uiHome/Index`.
2. `pages/A2uiHome/Index.ets:1029` `@State private cloudBackend: string = 'workswarm'` (shipped default) → `:8896` `HomePage({ … cloudChat: true (':8928') … })`.
3. `pages/A2uiHome/components/HomePage.ets:1192` `this.CloudComposerFiles(...)` inside `if (this.cloudChat)` (`:1191`).
4. `HomePage.ets:980` `CloudComposerFiles` → `:981` `ComposerFileStrip({ files: this.cloudFiles, … })`.

No constant `false`, no debug flag, no dead branch: `cloudBackend` defaults to `'workswarm'`, `cloudChat` is set to `true` by the page, and none of the touched files references `isDebugBuild`.

## Test: red → green → mutation

- **Red** `cbc93c7` (test only, +89) on `main` `04621bb`: `ℹ tests 5 / pass 0 / fail 5`, verbatim:
  `AssertionError [ERR_ASSERTION]: FilePresentation.ets must expose composerFileStatusAnnouncement(name, status, language)` (and the same for `composerFileActionAnnouncement`).
- **Green** `716523a`: `ℹ tests 5 / pass 5 / fail 0`. Test file byte-identical: `git diff --stat cbc93c7 716523a -- tests/unit/composer-attachment-announcements.test.mjs` is **empty**.

  ```
  + actual - expected
  + 'report.pdf，上传失败'
  - 'report.pdf, upload failed'
  ```
  restored → `ℹ tests 5 / pass 5 / fail 0`.

## Content anchoring (no line numbers)

Each assertion finds its element by the function name or the call text, never by a line number — adding or removing an unrelated line cannot turn it red. Example from the wiring test:

```js
assert.ok(strip.includes(call),
  'ComposerFileStrip.ets must announce through ' + call + '…), not an inline Chinese-only string');
const start = strip.indexOf(call);
assert.match(strip.slice(start, start + 200), /this\.language|digitalmateClientContext\(\)\.language|language\)/,
  'the ' + call + '…) call must pass the device language');
```

One assertion block per control: the status announcement (zh and en) and the cancel/remove announcement (zh and en), plus one for the strip wiring.

Byte-identical: the combined CJK string-literal multiset of `FilePresentation.ets` + `ComposerFileStrip.ets` is **12 literals on `main` and 12 on the branch, and the two multisets are identical** — the same strings moved from the component into the pure module. Fixes #451 — 底部导航的两个标签对读屏只念「对话」「发现」，没有角色、也没有选中态。

## 改动

`digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/pages/A2uiHome/components/HomeBottomNav.ets:49-66`（对话 tab）与 `:67-86`（发现 tab）：每个 tab 的 `Column` 上补三行——

```ets
.accessibilityGroup(true)   // 图标 + 文字合并成一个被播报的节点
.accessibilityLevel('yes')  // 该节点保持可聚焦
.accessibilityText(this.activeIndex === 0 ? '对话，标签页，已选中' : '对话，标签页，未选中')
```

选中态直接绑在 `activeIndex` 上（`:58` / `:79`），没有引入新状态；`.onClick(() => this.onSwitchTab(0|1))` 原样不动，布局、尺寸、图标切换逻辑一行未改。

## 为什么这样修

`HomeBottomNav.ets` 原本 88 行内没有任何可访问属性（`grep -c accessibilityText` = 0）：每个 tab 是自绘 `Column` + `Text`，选中与否只体现在填充/描边图标上，读屏拿不到「这是标签页」和「我在哪一页」。会话页 `pages/DigitalMateHome/Index.ets:3998-4001` 与发现页 `pages/A2uiHome/Index.ets:9325-9335` 各渲染一次，唯一条件是键盘收起 / `homeBottomNavVisibleNow()`，release 可达、无 debug 闸门；`entryability/EntryAbility.ets:660-661` 首启即进这条壳。因此补名、补角色、补状态。

## 测试（`tests/unit/home-bottom-nav-a11y.test.mjs`，新增 3 条）

先红后绿，命令均为 `node --test tests/unit/home-bottom-nav-a11y.test.mjs`：

1. **红**（组件仍是 main `9eea155` 的版本）：`ℹ tests 3 / pass 0 / fail 3`——两个 tab 的 `accessibilityText` / `accessibilityGroup` 都缺失，`accessibilityLevel('yes')` 计数为 0。
2. **绿**（本 PR `77b4e74`）：`ℹ tests 3 / pass 3 / fail 0`。
3. **变异**：把对话 tab 的名字改成常量 `'对话，标签页'`（去掉选中态分支）→ `pass 2 / fail 1`（`the 对话 tab announces its role and selection state` 变红）→ 还原 → `pass 3 / fail 0`。

测试断言的是结构而不是某一行文本：从每个 `Text('对话'|'发现')` 到该 tab 自己的 `.onClick` + `})` 之间，必须出现 `accessibilityGroup(true)`、可访问名里含标签文字 + `标签页` + `已选中`/`未选中` + `activeIndex === 0|1`，并保持 `onSwitchTab(0|1)` 仍在同一块内。

## 非目标 / 风险 / 回滚

- 非目标：不改布局、不换图标、不改切换逻辑、不新增组件、不做导航结构重构。
- 风险：低。纯增量属性，最坏情况是读屏文案多一行，视觉与交互零变化。
- 回滚：revert 本 PR 即可，无数据迁移、无配置项、无新增依赖。

## 没跑

`hvigor` 构建、Hypium、真机/TalkBack（沙箱无 ArkTS 工具链与设备）。相关文件 `tests/unit/ai-generated-label.test.mjs` 在本分支与 main 上都有同一条既有失败（`HTML current and historical replies keep one visible disclosure…`），与本次改动无关。

## What & why

Issue #353 asks for a WeChat-style "新消息" experience. The bot review on the
issue correctly found that the floating "↓" button already exists
(`showJumpToLatest` / `jumpToLatest`), so this PR implements only the part that
was actually missing:

- **Unread boundary.** When the reader leaves the bottom of the list, the last
  settled row is recorded. A live stream row is skipped on purpose: when it
  commits it becomes a different row id, and the finished reply must still
  count as new.
- **"新消息" divider.** The first assistant reply after that boundary carries a
  blue "新消息" divider (rendered inside its `ListItem`, so list indices used by
  `scrollToIndex` stay stable).
- **"↓ 新消息" button.** The existing floating button now shows the unread label
  and count (capped at `99+`), plus an accessibility label. With no unread
  replies it stays the plain "↓" as before.
- **Clearing.** Reaching the first unseen reply advances the boundary (the
  divider moves to the next unseen one); jumping to the latest or reaching the
  bottom clears the state. Switching room/topic or changing account resets it.

Nothing changes when the user is at the bottom: the list keeps auto-following
and no hint appears.

New `tests/unit/digitalmate-unread-indicator.test.mjs` covers the three states
from the issue (at bottom / reading history / returning to the page), the

## What & why

Issue #373 reports that the Beebou execution strip shows one low-information
line ("正在执行 · 请查看附件…") for the whole run, so a long task looks black-box
and stalled.

The step name already exists when the gateway sends `digitalmate.activity`
events (`正在阅读：…`, `正在搜索：…`), but there was no signal that time was
passing. This PR adds that missing signal:

  task title — the title is what has to ellipsize at the 180 vp caption limit.
- The clock stops in `onPageHide` and `aboutToDisappear`.

Scope note: this is deliberately the visible-change part of #373. It does not
invent a percentage or per-step progress the gateway does not report; granular
progress (success/stuck hints, expandable step log) would need a server-side
event contract and can follow separately.

## 决定：URL 边界与 #408 同构（方案 a），另补回基线本来就排除的 `]` 和 `}`

执行过程提取来源链接时，采用 #408 在 `CloudMessage.ets:143` 定下的那条边界——`https?:\/\/` 后不允许空白、引号、尖括号、`(`/`)` 以及 CJK/全角标点区段（`\u2000-\u206f`、`\u3000-\u303f`、`\u3400-\u4dbf`、`\u4e00-\u9fff`、`\uff00-\uffef`）。理由：`brief()` 遮的是同一类工具文本，本函数从同一份 `step.text` 里取链接，两处边界一旦分叉，同一句中文里的同一个 URL 会在遮罩面和点击面得到两个不同结果。

在这条边界上只有三处**为「可点击」服务**的差异，都写进了代码注释：

1. **补回 `]` `}`**：基线原类 `[^\s"'<>\]\}]+` 本来就排除这两个字符，而 `#408` 的遮蔽类省掉了它们。遮蔽时多带一个字符无害；这里要把 URL 交给 `openLink`，`见 [https://example.com/a] 结束` 就会点开 `https://example.com/a]`（404）。所以边界用「#408 的类 + `\]` `\}`」。
1b. **CJK 汉字留在地址里**（评审 High，已在 `376d004` 修）：#408 的类停在中日韩汉字上，那对**遮蔽**是对的（它替换字节），但对**要打开的链接**会把 `https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/中文` 砍成站点根 `https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/`（实测），这比「吞一句正文」更糟。所以地址里允许 CJK 汉字、只以 CJK/全角**标点**收尾——这正是气泡自动链接 `CloudMarkdown.ets:75` 已经在用的同一套切法。标注一句残余：`https://example.com/a其中3条`（汉字紧贴 ASCII 且无标点）仍会被吞进地址，与气泡行为一致，属已知取舍。
2. **成对括号回接**：边界把 `(` 整组切掉，而维基式地址 `https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Function_(mathematics)` 的括号属于地址。这里在边界之后仅回接**配平**的括号组（含嵌套）；不配平的 `(`/`)` 仍留在地址外。
3. **ASCII 句末标点**：`.,;:!?*` 不属于地址（`。`、`，` 已由区段排除）。尾部连续剥掉；路径里的 `/`、`%`、`=`、`&`、`#`、`?` 不动（有测试钉住）。`https://x.com/a?` 这类空查询会被剥成 `https://x.com/a`，打开的是同一页面，判断为可接受。

没有把 `CloudMessage.ets` 里的字符类抽成共享常量：该文件正被 #408 占用，本轮不碰（这是本轮唯一的重复，注释里写明指向 `CloudMessage.ets:143`）。

## 改了什么

- `digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/pages/CloudHome/CloudExecutionViewModel.ets`：`executionResources()` 的链接提取改用上述边界，并在入结果集合前做配平括号回接与句末标点裁剪；`seen` 去重、`titles` 映射（查不到时回退到未修剪的原始匹配）、文件路径提取、其他规则都不变。
- `tests/unit/cloud-execution-view.test.mjs`：新增 6 个测试（边界、括号、合法 URL 语法、去重计数、文本紧邻中文、`]`/`}` 包裹），**没有改动任何既有断言**（diff 里 `^-[^-]` = 0）。

修好后：来源行展示与点击打开的 URL 一致；同一 URL 带不同尾部标点只算一个来源。

## 可达链与单一数据通路（release 路径）

- 渲染：`CloudMessageCard.ets:392-405` → `onOpenProcessLink(link.url)`；详情面板 `Index.ets:1996-2001` → `openProcessLink(item.url)`
- 打开：`Index.ets:1927-1938`，只校验 `/^https?:\/\//` 就 `host.openLink(url)`
- 计数：`CloudExecutionViewModel.ets:237`（`executionWebSourceCount` 内部 `flatMap(step => executionResources(...))`）、`:254-256`（`executionDetailLabel` 同样 `flatMap(executionResources(...))` + `new Set(...)`）——**没有第二条正则**，计数跟着同一个函数走

## 证据（`main@7fbaa28`，node v24.22.2）

命令：`node --test tests/unit/cloud-execution-view.test.mjs`

| 状态 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| 未修（仅加断言） | `32 tests / 26 pass / 6 fail` |
